verdict.rationale: Several evidence items were fetched directly from https://docs.riveterhq.com/openapi.yaml, with content describing the API's endpoints (enrich, datasets, scrape, search), webhooks and limits, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The probe's 404s covered only JSON/swagger paths, not the YAML file, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: docs that explicitly point to the spec download, independent or hands-on validation of the spec's completeness, and a JSON variant at the conventional probed paths.
